purpose: PixiJS版の箱舞台へ統合済みのラスタ舞台美術。欠損時は同義のPixi Graphicsへ縮退する。

visualStyle: Japanese kamishibai and peep-show paper craft
visible paper fibers, cut edges, wooden proscenium
cute industrial fantasy with dry black comedy
constraints: 既存キャラクターを描き直さない
文字、ロゴ、透かしを入れない
正面投影で320:192の舞台座標へ合わせる
ライティング方向は左上から右下
UI、状態表示、イベント文言を画像へ焼き込まない

files.role: 最前面の木製ボックスシアター枠
files.prompt: Front-facing handcrafted wooden box theatre proscenium, warm worn walnut, small brass nails, shallow carved trim, transparent stage opening and transparent exterior, no curtains, no text.
Left theatre curtain cutout, deep oxblood red paper-cloth hybrid, visible folds and scalloped paper edge, front view, transparent background, no ornaments or text.
Right theatre curtain cutout matching the left curtain exactly, deep oxblood red paper-cloth hybrid, visible folds and scalloped paper edge, front view, transparent background, no ornaments or text.
Wide scalloped puppet-theatre valance matching the side curtains, oxblood paper-cloth, subtle hand-painted highlights, front view, transparent background, no crest, no logo, no text.

files.role: Token燃焼中の交換式背景紙
files.prompt: Layered paper theatre backdrop of an industrial forest at dusk, smoky aubergine sky, muted ochre hills, visible cut-paper seams, empty center-right space for a forge and characters, no characters, no factory, no fire, no text.

files.role: Chill／回復中の交換式背景紙
files.prompt: Layered paper theatre backdrop of a recovering forest after rain, dusty blue sky and sage-green hills, visible cut-paper seams, calm but not utopian, empty center-right space for characters and a resting forge, no characters, no factory, no text.

files.role: 紙人形を置く遠近付き舞台床
files.prompt: Trapezoid miniature theatre floor made from stained card and thin wooden slats, subtle diagonal perspective, worn hand-painted edges, front view, transparent background, no props, no text.
